focused_verifier_obligations: The schema_digest and authority_digest are recomputed; audit baseline and status do not occur in the HIR instance.
All nested occurrence profiles inherit the root profile because no nested profile override field exists.
A CURRENT body validates only Current patterns; an EXPLICIT_PREVIEW body may validate the nine Preview patterns only with FEATURE_GATED nonempty required features.
Every required feature ID is a member of the exact root feature set and all feature arrays are deterministically sorted.
Every payload_ref resolves in the same body and its owner, expression kind, payload contract, ordered slot roles, reference classes, and cardinalities exactly equal one catalog payload contract.

Every structural plan matches exactly one of the thirteen closed StructuralPlan discriminators, every plan and nested sum or product rejects additional fields, and every optional value is present as its required *_or_null encoding.

Every ClosurePlan preserves one body-local CapturePlanId, capture-list state, residence, closed assertion, sorted unique lexical dependencies, and a source-ordered tagged ReferenceCapture or InitializerCapture sum with unique CaptureFieldId, contiguous source_ordinal, exact normalized type, and LET or VAR initializer kind.

Closure capture operands evaluate left-to-right exactly once; any precommit failure rolls back acquired state in reverse order; the complete environment commits before infallible CLOSURE_MAKE; no partial environment or closure can be published.
CapturePlanId, CaptureFieldId, EvalId, place, region, loan, reservation, cleanup, construction, closure, and MIR value identities are forbidden from module API export.

Every structural-plan reference resolves in the required domain with the cataloged owning or nonowning cardinality and order; plan IDs and ordinals are unique, ordinals are contiguous, and every named plan-reference slot resolves to exactly one actual structural plan of the required class.

Every construction lifecycle budget reference resolves to one module-level type-header cleanup budget record; its envelopes are sorted-unique, its contribution kinds are closed, and its computed envelope is proven a subset of its effective envelope.
Every owning child has exactly one parent, every nonowning reference resolves, and orphan, cyclic, cross-body, duplicate, and multiply-owned payloads are rejected.
Every lowering-row hir_identity_ids value resolves to exactly one of the 128 identity rows and exactly matches the lowering dispatch key.
Only LOWER and NO_RUNTIME_EMISSION lowering rows exist; capability insufficiency preserves the verified HIR digest exactly and prevents ExecutableHirH1 creation.

Every normalized type ID has exactly one descriptor; qualifier, base type, parameter mode, region relation, API residue, and MIR projection remain separate, and a borrowed or inout descriptor has one required region while owner descriptors have none.

A verification receipt validates against deeplus.canonical-hir-h1-verification-receipt/r1 with exact input digests, profile and feature set, PASS-only root/profile/cross-reference/payload/structural-plan results, zero recovery/unknown identities, deterministic RFC 8949 CBOR, and no additional fields.
